el.Autorretratos intervenidos. Un cuerpo de: Altered self-portraits. A body of work capable of eating itself.
el.Desde niña, tenía fantasías sobre temas: Ever since I was a little girl, I had fantasies about serious things. I imagined that in any situation of extreme deprivation, emergency, war, abandonment or poverty, I would not die. Above all, I would not die of hunger, because I would turn to myself.
el.Algo muy primitivo, de naturaleza antrop: Something very primitive, anthropophagic in nature, which, far from frightening me, I accepted with a child's natural ease. As time went by, with reality, climate change, the pandemic, wars and so much misery, those feelings and memories came back.
el.Decidí capturarlos con mi cámara. Explor: I decided to capture them with my camera. To explore them with my body. I prepared my provisions: altered self-portraits. Transformations of my body into food, into something to be consumed. Treating the body as a photographic object and as the subject necessary to exist, resist and survive. Because without it, there is no life.
el.«Víveres» resulta un plato fuerte. Sazon: “Víveres” is a main course, seasoned with a pinch of dark humor. A body of work capable of eating itself.
el.Me pregunto también, ¿somos lo que comem: I also wonder: are we what we eat?
el.Tocá un plato para verlo. Cada imagen es: Tap a dish to view it. Each image is an altered self-portrait.
el.Escribile a Andrea para llevar «Víveres»: Write to Andrea to bring “Víveres” to a venue, a publication or your collection.
